note: The Credit Information Law's implementing regulations, article 17, in the Saudi Central Bank's rulebook: a credit bureau may keep negative information in a consumer's record no more than five years from the debt's settlement. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Saudi Central Bank Rulebook, Implementing Regulations of the Credit Information Law, Article (17)
sources.said: A company shall have the right to keep any negative information in a consumer’s credit record for a period not exceeding five years from the date the debt is settled or the dispute is resolved.
